name: hero-heatmap

frames.best_why: The bolt is at its brightest, a full rainbow from blue edge to hot pink core, and the whole shape is visible.

tagline: A rainbow heatmap lightning bolt glows beside the headline.
summary: A split landing hero with a two-line headline, short paragraph, pill button and two tech badges on the left, and a glowing lightning-bolt heatmap on the right. The bolt pulses through blue, green, yellow and magenta.
appearance: On black, a left column stacks a large white two-line heading, a dim paragraph, an outlined pill button and two bordered badges. The right visual is a lightning-bolt silhouette shown as a heat map, its edges glowing blue, green and yellow around a hot pink core.
behaviour: The bolt's heat field breathes, going from a faint blue outline to a full rainbow flare and back within a few seconds. The text and buttons hold still; hover lifts the button and badges, and on small screens the glow becomes a band under the copy.
demo_content: Heading AI SDK Agents / Copy and Paste, copy about Vercel AI SDK, Next.js v16 and AI SDK v6 badges.
search_phrases: thermal heat map of a shape
ai product landing hero with glow
split hero text and glowing icon
use_when: A launch page wants one glowing symbol to carry the hero, with the headline and copy beside it.
avoid_when: The glow loop never stops and needs WebGL, and the bolt is a data-URI image you have to replace.
customise: Text, CTA and badges are props, and the heatmap accepts its image, colour ramp, contour, glow and speed. Layout and glow placement are class edits.
weight_why: A heatmap WebGL shader glows continuously across half the hero.

a11y.note: A hidden h1 and a text link serve screen readers, but the pulsing shader has no reduced-motion stop.

issues: The bolt fades almost to black in frames 1 and 4, so its shape briefly disappears.
The description is small and dim against black, so it is easy to miss.
polish_why: A striking rainbow glow and clean split layout, though the bolt vanishes in its dim phase.
